verdict.rationale: Teller documents a payments resource for sending payments on behalf of the end-user, but only via Zelle, and nothing describes variable recurring payments, standing consents, or recurring debit flows. The live-balance check before an ACH debit is an adjacent feature for the developer's own debit flow, not a Teller recurring-payment capability.

support.subject: As a developer, recurring bank payments are supported — variable recurring payments, standing consents, or documented recurring debit flows built on the connection
